decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the SK6812 Mini-E selection and its 3.3V supply requirement.
The same-message MODIFY already adds the SK6812 Mini-E LEDs to the complete 3.3V rail powered during standalone USB operation.
Selecting the specific SK6812 Mini-E part does not change the existing requirement to display charge status through the SK6812 addressable LED chain.
Confirming that the selected SK6812 Mini-E LEDs use 3.3V necessarily adds them to the DCDC1-powered 3.3V loads during normal operation.

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA219, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, AM312, and SK6812 Mini-E LEDs when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: The LED part and supply-voltage decision does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or interboard cabling.
The selected LED part does not change native USB enumeration, connector sourcing, or D+/D- routing.
The LED selection does not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The LED part and voltage decision does not resolve or alter the battery connector family, part number, or pin order.
The source selects an LED part and voltage but does not change the recorded power-board BOM obligations or listed charge-LED components.
The current 5V-boost load list already excludes the LEDs, so confirmation that the selected LEDs use 3.3V leaves this requirement unchanged.
The existing statement that AXP2101 powers all system loads during normal operation already encompasses the selected LEDs without requiring an attribute change.
